title: Weight-only INT8 CICD synthetic probe and degradation audit
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an automated CI/CD probe and degradation-audit workflow for INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles. The probe will run on PRs that change quantization codepaths and nightly to detect quality regressions or calibration instability. We need deterministic synthetic probes, telemetry instrumentation, gating rules for merges, and an operations runbook for investigating failures.
background: Recent deployments of weight-only INT8 profiles (GPTQ/AWQ) uncovered intermittent accuracy regressions when calibration parameters drifted across model variants and sequence lengths. Existing regression suites are heavy-weight and slow; we need a fast synthetic probe that approximates customer-facing failure modes and surfaces degradations in CI with clear rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A CI job (Buildkite/GH Actions) that runs within 20 minutes on a PR and produces a pass/fail verdict for quantization changes
Synthetic probe dataset (<=200 prompts) representing short/long sequences, multilingual, instruction/QA, and tricky numerics
Gated thresholds for numeric similarity (embedding cosine >= 0.92) + token-level divergence tolerances for top-k outputs
Automatic telemetry emitted to Loki/Prometheus for model drift counters, per-profile accuracy delta, and p95 latency
Failure runbook created in Confluence with triage steps and rollback playbook
Nightly full degradation-audit run that replays longer evaluation sets and stores artifacts for diffing
implementation_notes: Probe implemented as a lightweight harness that calls the same serving runtime path used in production (via a test-only route) to exercise kernel selection and KV cache behavior
Use model-subset sampling: run GPTQ and AWQ variants per-PR by default; only schedule full-model runs on nightly
Calibration harness will run weight-only calibration with a fixed seed and deterministic input preprocessing to maximize reproducibility
Telemetry: emit tags for (model, profile_id, profile_type, sequence_length_bucket, kernel_variant) and metrics: accuracy_delta, avg_latency_ms, memory_peak_mb
CI gating rule: PRs that change files under /quantization or /runtime/kernel selection must run the probe and are blocked on failure
Persist golden outputs for the probe in an S3 bucket; store diffs as artifacts on the PR for review
test_plan: PR probe: run synthetic probe on changed PRs using GitHub Actions matrix of 2 model variants (small/medium) and both GPTQ/AWQ pathways
Nightly audit: run extended regression harness (2k prompts) with full accuracy metrics and generate an audit report stored in /artifacts/quant-audits/YYYY-MM-DD.json
Metric checks: embedding cosine, normalized log-prob delta, and top-3 exact-match rate. Thresholds configurable via runtime config and stored with the profile metadata
Chaos validation: introduce a mocked kernel fallback in a branch and ensure probe detects a notable accuracy/latency regression
Backcompat: ensure weight-only INT8 canary with legacy FP16 path still meets baseline within configured epsilon
